Small portions and food was not great in quality and taste
Jul 2025 • Family
I recently visited this Indian restaurant that turned out to be a major disappointment. The prices were unreasonably high for what was offered, and the food quality did not match the cost. Dishes lacked authentic flavor and tasted bland. To make matters worse, the service was painfully slow, with an unusually long wait time before any food arrived at the table. The overall experience felt frustrating and underwhelming. Despite the promising menu and inviting ambiance, the poor execution left little to be desired. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone seeking good Indian cuisine.
Written July 22, 2025
